contents.text: What was Netflix's net cash provided by operating activities, sum up the numbers?

Netflix's net cash provided by operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $10,149,273 thousand, for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $7,361,364 thousand, and for the year ended December 31, 2023 was $7,274,301 thousand. (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements and PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
